# Release Notes

## Version 0.0.0 - Clean Foundation (October 1, 2025)

**Initial stable release** with complete repository optimization.

### Highlights
- 🚀 One-command setup (`./QUICK_START.sh`)
- 📚 Clean documentation structure (10 root files)
- 🔒 Security policy and best practices
- 🏗️ Complete architecture documentation
- ⚡ Simplified dependencies (16 → 5 core packages)
- 🛠️ Professional development tooling

### Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yawningbrain/project_mindgames.git
cd project_mindgames
./QUICK_START.sh
```

### What's Included
- Clean, typed Python codebase
- Streamlit web application
- LSL server for EEG streaming
- Data export and analysis tools
- Comprehensive documentation
- CI/CD workflows
- Development tools (Makefile, pre-commit)

### Breaking Changes
None - this is the initial stable foundation.
